verdict.rationale: RunAnywhere's own documented capability is an explicit choice between on-device and hosted execution. Prompts, audio, and images stay on the device and work offline, and a request leaves the machine only when the user opts in (e.g. `--cloud`). That gives the user real control over whether data stays local, but there is no evidence of choosing a storage region or residency for the hosted Wally Cloud. missing for 10: cloud region/residency selection, documentation of where hosted data is stored or retained, independent corroboration.
